cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: The Pattern
cards.instruction: Treat every minor detail as evidence of a much larger problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll sort this communication failure out. Nobody got my meeting email; the whole office is working blind.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's in your drafts. You forgot to press send.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good catch. You can check the outgoing messages with me. A system that depends on one finger is more fragile than I thought.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll press send. Go and eat your lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent, you can cover this end. Choose the handover note and I'll follow it. If one sandwich needs a deputy, we must have an entire succession problem waiting in the canteen.

reason: Have A accept B checking/sending help as an adapted leadership arrangement, while magnifying a draft email and lunch cover into institutional fragility.
